💡 Tips

  • 1.Always bookmark the official Department of Home Affairs website and check for updates before making any decisions.
  • 2.Set up a My Health Declaration account early — you will need it for the health examination step.
  • 3.Start your English test preparation well in advance — superior English scores can make a big difference in points.
  • 4.Keep all your documents organized in one place from the beginning — you will need certified translations and work references.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is SkillSelect?
SkillSelect is the online system where you submit your Expression of Interest (EOI) for skilled migration. If invited, you can then apply for a visa.
Where can I check my visa application status?
You can check your application status through your ImmiAccount on the Department of Home Affairs website.
What English tests are accepted?
Common accepted tests include IELTS, PTE Academic, TOEFL iBT, and Cambridge English. Check the Department of Home Affairs website for the current list.
